title: Danny Donator - Take Your Time
htmlContent:
Danny Donator returns with "Take Your Time," his new R&B anthem. Danny Donator has been making a name for himself over the past few months; with his most recent single, "Take Your Time," Danny Donator is doing something different. Guys like Danny Donator are pushing the whole genre into a new stratosphere.

"Take Your Time" hit in every way, and the production brings a hard Trap R&B that sets a tone for his style to blossom. Danny Donator is on the verge of doing something he hasn't done before. His pleasant flow outpours in his delivery. This song can match the fans in a new way.

Danny Donator's "Take Your Time" is available on all streaming outlets.
